text:
Ava: Heads-up — shipping welcome kits for the April Beta cohort starting next Mon. Want to sync on a short activation microcycle + feedback checkpoints. TL;DR: 3 waves, ~100 seats, staggered invites + 2 product walkthroughs. Planning to run quick NPS microsurveys D3 and D14.

Jamal: Got it. Quick Q — can we get a final enroll CSV by EOD Fri? AE side needs to send account invites.

Priya: I can produce that. Which columns do you want? email, company, seat_count, timezone, primary_contact?

Marcus: Add one more: trial_feature_flags (so eng can gate previews). Also tagging for analytics.

Ava: Yes to all. Priya, please drop CSV to #customer-success-attachments or share the link here. Format: email,company,seat_count,timezone,contact,flags.

Priya: Uploading sample now — filename: enrollments_beta_wave1.csv. Preview link: https://files.redwood.co/preview/enrollments_beta_wave1.csv

Jamal: For invite sequencing, plan to send in batches of 25 every 2 hours to avoid email throttles and spikes on our onboarding routes.

Jamal: Example invite payload we’ll use (devs can reuse):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.co/invite \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","cohort":"beta-apr","template":"beta-2026"}'
```

OnboardingBot: Reminder: onboarding playbook "beta-welcome-v1" scheduled 2026-04-05 15:00 UTC — calendar invites sent to participants.

Elise: For feedback loops, I propose: day 3 NPS micro (1-2 Qs + 1 open), and a day 14 more detailed check-in with a short product checkbox matrix. Who's owning copy + survey delivery?

Marcus: I’ll draft the day-3 copy and wire the in-app modal. Suggest keeping the modal to 3 touchpoints max so we don’t annoy customers.

Priya: Uploads complete: wave1 shows 96 seats confirmed, timezone skew to PST. Flags column populated for early-access features A/B. Link again: https://files.redwood.co/preview/enrollments_beta_wave1.csv

Ava: Perfect. Owners: @Elise = survey copy + cadence, @Marcus = in-app modal + instrumentation, @Jamal = invite sequencing, @Priya = enrollment list and flags. Assets (welcome kit PDF, links) are in the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.co/beta-assets/apr-2026. Next sync: tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:

Elise: Confirmed — I'll post survey copy here by EOD and tag @Ava for sign-off. Any immediate risks?

Jamal: One risk — corporate tenants with strict SPAM rules. I'll surface any denies early and reroute.

Ava: Noted. If a tenant blocks, we’ll drop them to wave2 and offer self-serve register link. Thanks everyone!
